description: DAY 0 master heroic v2 - using gpt-image-1 for better text rendering
prompt: ECUAMAN, official superhero mascot of Ecuanutrition. Anatomically accurate Penaeus vannamei (Pacific whiteleg shrimp) anthropomorphized as Pixar-style underwater hero. Full body vertical heroic three-quarter pose facing camera. CRITICAL ANATOMY: a single segmented orange (hex F39A2B) curved shrimp body with six clearly defined abdominal segments, fan tail at the bottom with central pointed telson and lateral uropods, NO human legs, NO boots — the lower body MUST be the curved shrimp tail. Muscular humanoid torso fused with the cefalotorax showing six-pack abs through the orange shell. Two muscular humanoid arms (NO gloves). The right hand holds a tall glowing CYAN AQUA energy trident (hex 00D9FF) with three prongs and bright blue plasma halo. The left arm is flexed showing bicep, BARE skin matching body color. Head has a serrated rostrum (saw-like beak) with 8 small teeth on top, two large round expressive cartoon eyes on short eyestalks. TWO long thin flexible antennae longer than the body, clearly drawn, ending in dual ribbon tassels: one red ribbon (hex CE1126) and one yellow ribbon (hex FFDD00) — the Ecuadorian flag colors. COSTUME: a royal blue (hex 0046AD) flowing cape billowing dramatically backwards, attached at the shoulders only. An electric blue (hex 1E88E5) belt around the waist. EXACTLY ONE circular medallion centered on the belt: gold ring border (hex F2C744), blue center, with a clean stylized white letter E in the middle — this is the ONLY medallion in the entire image, do not put any medallion on the chest. The text 'ECUAMAN' written in bold white capital sans-serif letters across the belt below the medallion. BACKGROUND: deep Pacific Ocean dark blue gradient hex 001A3D to 003A7D, three diagonal sunlight god rays from upper-left, soft bioluminescent particles. STYLE: clean DreamWorks Pixar 3D semi-realistic, friendly proud confident smile, cinematic underwater lighting with cyan rim light. Sharp focus, vibrant colors.
